chapters.prompt: Scan current and historical FUSE work for reusable artifacts and capabilities before likely future build work becomes critical.
Detect overlapping systems or capabilities early and prepare merge, alias or retirement paths before duplication expands.
Watch material provider capability or reliability changes and prepare route changes before they create outages.
Estimate context, runtime, queue and rate-limit headroom and checkpoint or reroute before visible interruption.
Identify forthcoming slow stages and precompute, parallelize or move them to durable execution before they delay the owner.
